dataset.context: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-restaurant single-tenant — small dataset; index health visible only at scale

env.method: Service-layer probe via tinker + Laravel QueryLog; LCP via Playwright PerformanceObserver / paint entries; HTTP curl warm timings against dev server

Same root as stock_levels — paired snapshotForItem call. 8 wizard items × 2 queries = 16 of the 46 total queries are addressable N+1

slow_query_log.recommendation_v1: OFF on V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne is acceptable (small dataset, dev box). For V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog: enable slow_query_log with long_query_time=1 in MySQL prod my.cnf, log to /var/log/mysql/slow.log + pt-query-digest cron

lcp_measurements.note: Auth was sticky during this session — fresh /login was redirected. Document instead: login Blade is the same SPA shell; the login surface lazy-loads ONLY the login form Vue chunk + admin-shell + app.js. Equivalent stack ≈ admin dashboard.

lcp_measurements.lcp_note: PerformanceObserver returned no LCP entries — single low-imagery idle splash; FCP ≈ LCP proxy

observations: app.js (7.18MB) is loaded on EVERY surface including kiosk-idle and OSS. This single bundle dominates parse/eval time on every page load.
admin-shell.js (6.17MB) is additional admin-only bundle — loaded on POS+dashboard but not on kiosk-idle/OSS surfaces (good).

pos-wizard.js (290KB transfer / unminified ~296KB on disk) is the Vanilla JS POS wizard — FROZEN ZONE per CLAUDE.md §7. Loaded on every admin surface because served via {{ asset('js/pos-wizard.js') }} in admin-pos-v4.blade.php.
Parse time NOT directly measured (Chrome devtools required) — but transferSize duration + FCP ≈ 3300ms across ALL surfaces tells the story: app.js+vendor.js are blocking initial paint.
fix_hints: Split app.js: surface-specific entry chunks (kiosk-app, pos-app, kds-app, oss-app) instead of monolithic app.js loaded everywhere
Lazy-import Vue route components — currently FCP=3300ms suggests synchronous full-tree parse
Defer pos-wizard.js to admin-pos surface only via Blade conditional (currently loaded on every blade extending the admin layout)
vendor.js (1.89MB) is unlikely splittable without breaking change — accept as baseline
Owner mandate FROZEN ZONE on pos-wizard.js: do NOT modify content; load conditionally via {{ ... }} guard in admin Blade — design intact, network footprint reduced

budget_summary.note_v1_local: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box dev server — FCP=3.3s acceptable for in-store kiosk/admin (not customer mobile web). For V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog: bundle split is REQUIRED before cloud + mobile customer surfaces are wired.

summary: DB layer: 9 of 10 endpoints HEALTHY (1-7 queries, all <12ms). One real N+1 finding on /api/frontend/menu (46 queries, 16 addressable).
Index coverage: WELL_COVERED on all 5 hot tables — no missing indexes detected for current query shapes.
Slow query log: OFF (acceptable V1 LOCAL, V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog item).
Bundle: ALL surfaces over FCP 1.8s budget (avg 3315ms = 84% overrun). app.js 7.18MB + admin-shell.js 6.17MB are the dominant blockers.
LCP: PerformanceObserver returned mostly null because Le Cayenne admin UI emits FCP ≈ LCP (single-image splash + DOM tree). Only dashboard surfaced LCP=3396ms — over 2.5s budget by 36%.
